_status: NON-NORMATIVE. Each entry names a property violation and the guard that must go red when it is introduced. A guard that has never been observed to fail is an untested assertion with a Makefile target.
_isolation: Every mutation runs in a throwaway git worktree created from HEAD and removed afterwards. The primary worktree is never mutated: the thing being proven is that a guard goes red, and the cost of proving it must not be the working tree.

mutations._unreachable_reason: Behaviourally indistinguishable on every valid current state: NO entry in the canonical registry lacks establishing sources, so the condition this mutation weakens is universally satisfied and the mutated code computes the same value. The state it would exploit is made unreachable one layer down by `make banzai-answer-policy-check`, which fails when an entry declared deterministic has no answer or no registered source. Recorded as unreachable rather than killed: manufacturing an impossible fixture to produce a RED would prove the fixture, not the property.

mutations._kill_signal: PT/EN paired 30/30 -> 29/30. The aggregate --check gate is NOT the guard here: it is already red at baseline because 8 critical cases remain uncovered, so it would have reported RED whether or not the mutation landed. The pair count is the property this mutation actually attacks, and it moves.
